title: Eduversal Academic Year Arc — Calendar Anchors
description: Shared timing reference used by every role weekly-checklist JSON. Maps Indonesian curriculum calendar + Cambridge exam cycles + Eduversal network events onto the 40-week academic year (Sem-1 = W1-W18, mid-year break, Sem-2 = W19-W40).

indonesian_calendar_anchors.1: Tahun ajaran baru begins. MPLS for new students. RKAS implementation begins.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.2: Hari Kemerdekaan RI (17 Aug). First full instructional week.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.3: Baseline diagnostic assessments. Class lists finalised.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.4: First Week-4 PLC of the year. First Domain Heatmap reading.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.6: Mid-Sem-1 progress check. First parent communication round.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.8: Cambridge Oct/Nov standard entry deadline (late August historically).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.10: Mid-Semester I: EASE Week 1 — EASE Growth (Grades 7-12); lessons continue and Teacher-Paced Tests run inside normal periods. Sumpah Pemuda (28 Oct).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.12: Cambridge Oct/Nov exam series starts. Hari Pahlawan (10 Nov).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.14: Preparation for the Semester I Synchronized Test (EASE Week 2).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.16: EASE Week 2 — Semester I Synchronized Test (EASE Assessment / Common Assessment); lessons stop. Internal moderation cycle.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.17: Report card writing. Grading integrity audit window.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.18: Hari Ibu (22 Dec). Sem-1 close. Reports issued to parents. Winter recess.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.19: Semester 2 begins. Mid-year IPDL review window opens.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.21: Cambridge March/Feb registration deadline (mid October prior year).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.25: Mid-Semester II: EASE Week 3 — EASE Growth (Grades 7-12); lessons continue. Cambridge May/June registration (late February).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.27: Ramadhan window (variable Mar-May depending on year).
indonesian_calendar_anchors.29: Hari Kartini (21 Apr). Idul Fitri (variable). PPDB begins for following year.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.31: Hari Pendidikan Nasional (2 May). Cambridge May/June exam series.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.33: Cambridge May/June exam series in progress.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.35: Preparation for the Semester II Synchronized Test (EASE Week 4). Kenaikan kelas planning begins.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.37: End-of-year results analysis (Common Assessment and EASE Growth) and report preparation.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.39: Reports issued. Annual appraisal cycles complete.
indonesian_calendar_anchors.40: Year-end recess. Annual archive audit. New SIP drafting.

eduversal_network_anchors.1: Annual School Leadership Alignment & Strategic Development Workshop (Eduversal-led, all schools attend).
eduversal_network_anchors.2-3: School Appraisal Phase 0 — Kickoff (online, about 3 weeks before the school's Phase 1 visit): introduces the cycle and launches the school's Self-Evaluation.
eduversal_network_anchors.3-8: School Appraisal Phase 1 — Teaching Quality Visit (on-site): live window 5 August – 18 September 2026. Eduversal Subject Specialist lesson observations and walkthroughs during the visit are formative for teachers.
eduversal_network_anchors.7-13: Principal Appraisal — first leadership-observation (F2) window, Sept–Oct 2026, by the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director or an assigned observer. It may share a trip with a School Appraisal visit; the two stay separate.
eduversal_network_anchors.10: EASE Week 1 — mid-Semester I; EASE Growth (Grades 7-12); lessons continue. Live date: Semester I school week 12, 28 Sep – 2 Oct 2026 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).
eduversal_network_anchors.10-11: School Appraisal Phase 2 — Progress Check-in (online) with the Visit I Supervisor, completed by 18 October 2026.
eduversal_network_anchors.11-15: School Appraisal Phase 3 — Validation Visit (on-site): live window 7 October – 20 November 2026. Phases 0-3 are completed within Semester I.
eduversal_network_anchors.14-16: EASE Week 2 — Semester I Synchronized Test (EASE Assessment / Common Assessment); lessons stop. Live date: Semester I school week 22 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).
eduversal_network_anchors.16-18: Annual School Quality Report within three weeks of the Phase 3 visit (every school by mid-December 2026), with a Development Rating for each of the five domains — no composite school score. Within two weeks the school transfers its two School Development Priorities into the School Development Plan.
eduversal_network_anchors.21: EASE Growth for Grades 4-6 — once a year, 18-22 January 2027 (Semester II; Latihan.id).
eduversal_network_anchors.22-31: Principal Appraisal — second leadership-observation (F2) window, Feb–Apr 2027.
eduversal_network_anchors.25: EASE Week 3 — mid-Semester II; EASE Growth (Grades 7-12; exam-heavy grades may sit earlier); lessons continue. Live date: Semester II school week 13 (Secondary).
eduversal_network_anchors.33-35: EASE Week 4 — Semester II Synchronized Test (EASE Assessment / Common Assessment); lessons stop. Live date: Semester II school week 19 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).
eduversal_network_anchors.36-39: School Appraisal Phase 4 — Impact Review (online, May–June 2027): reviews the two School Development Priorities; it creates no new Domain Rating and does not reopen the Phase 3 rating.
eduversal_network_anchors.39-40: Annual Principal Appraisal cycle close. Network year-end review.

ease_assessment_windows.naming_note: AY 2026-2027 model: EASE (Eduversal Analytical & Skills Evaluation) is the umbrella name for three programmes. EASE Growth = reasoning + literacy benchmark (Mathematical Reasoning, Science Literacy, English Reading), curriculum-independent, never graded; twice a year for Grades 7-12 (EASE Weeks 1 and 3), once in Semester 2 for Grades 4-6; 2026-27 is Version 1 (baseline, not a growth score). EASE Assessment = Common Assessment: Teacher-Paced Tests every 1-3 chapters + a Synchronized Test at each semester-end (EASE Weeks 2 and 4). EASE Academic (formerly A-EASE) = teacher exam once per semester, formative only. The retired names EASE I/II are not used.
ease_assessment_windows.calendar_caveat: The week keys in this file follow the 40-week template, not the live school-week numbering. EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 sets the live dates (EASE Week 1 = Semester I week 12; Week 2 = Semester I week 22; Week 3 = Semester II week 13; Week 4 = Semester II week 19).

induction_window_alignment.note: Each induction runs from the person's own start date, not the school calendar; the week numbers below assume a start in week 1 and are approximate. Source: Induction Module: Overview 26-27 and the six track documents.

teacher_induction.stage_2_foundation: Semester 1, week 4 to the end of the term
teacher_induction.stage_4_integration_checkpoint: end of Semester 2 — led by the School Leader on the induction developmental rubric
teacher_induction.stage_5_consolidation: Semester 3 (Year 2, Semester I) — ends with the Final Induction Completion Review

principal_induction.duration: 12 months; extension only through a Foundation Representative review

academic_coordinator_induction.duration: one academic year (2 semesters), built as a rhythm that repeats every semester
academic_coordinator_induction.outcome: Readiness Checkpoint at the end of the first complete annual cycle — Ready or Extended

exams_officer_induction.phases: Phase 0 Preparation → Phase 1 Shadowed Entries → Phase 2 Supervised Live Delivery → Phase 3 Supervised Results & Dispatch → Phase 4 Full Independence & Certification (Certified or Extended)

school_induction.phases: Phase 1 Foundations Mapping (weeks 1-4) → Phase 2 Core Systems Build (rest of Semester 1) → Phase 3 Embedding & Practice (Semester 2) → Phase 4 Readiness Checkpoint (end of Year 1)

usage_notes: When a role JSON references a week number, that week number maps to the 40-week template above (W1 = the first instructional week of the academic year in July, NOT calendar week 1). The live dates in EASE Module: Schedule 26-27 and the School Appraisal documents always win over a template week.
Cambridge deadlines vary year-to-year — the week numbers are typical anchors; the seed script must accept a per-year override map.
The Eduversal network anchors show the windows in which Eduversal-led activities run; each school's exact dates for School Appraisal Phases 0-3 come from its own school-specific schedule.

Induction runs from each person's own start date: a teacher in Stage 2 (Foundation) is in Semester 1, week 4 to the end of the term, counted from their start. The weekly checklist's induction_overlay layers extra tasks on these weeks for that user only.
